item.title: Between 51 and 53 Leverton Street, 17th August
item.description:
Several pavement slabs have caved in and broken apart. The problem started with one slab last week and has since worsened significantly. This is a serious trip hazards for passer-bys, in particular the many elderly people and children who live on this road. Our concern is that the worsening condition points towards a deeper structural issue with pipe-work or the foundation of the empty council house number 53.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 51, Leverton Street, Kentish Town, Greater London
